section.title: Billing summary
section.description: What the comparsa owes the Federation for this order, at the edition's prices.
section.provisionalNote: Provisional: the amount can change until the Federation validates the order.
section.finalNote: Final: the Federation has validated the order. It follows the edition's current prices.
section.noTotal: There is no total until the Federation sets the price in the edition.

missingPrices_one: A price is missing in the edition: {{prices}}.
missingPrices_other: Prices are missing in the edition: {{prices}}.

edition.title: Edition billing summary
edition.description: What every prepared order owes, at the edition's prices.
edition.provisionalNote: Provisional while any order is not validated.
edition.finalNote: Final: the Federation has validated every prepared order.
edition.noTotal: There is no total until the Federation sets the price in the edition.
